insight: Plan bodies frequently embed code snippets in fenced blocks that read like apply_diff patches but omit the `@@ -N,M +N,M @@` hunk header. Pasting such a snippet straight into `file__apply_diff` fails with "no hunks found in the patch string". Fix: add a `@@ -<start>,<count> +<start>,<count> @@` line before the context/removed/added lines. Cheap habit: read the target file first to get real line numbers, then write the header.
